verdict.rationale: Brex's API paths are versioned (e.g. `POST /v2/users/create`), and Brex keeps a developer changelog of API additions, so versioning is partly evidenced. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or version-support guarantees. missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, explicit versioning scheme and lifecycle docs, version support/sunset windows, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Team API: Added Create user (`POST /v2/users/create`) to create an inactive employee without sending an invitation.
Payments API: Added `imad` and `omad` to transfer objects returned by List transfers, Get transfer, and Create transfer.
